name: mfaizanshaikh/calorie-coach-backend
description: Backend API for AI Calorie Coach iOS app (Google/Apple sign-in + meal sync).

ignore.PKSA-y2cr-5h3j-g3ys: CVE-2025-45769 (LOW). Advisory is about library accepting weak secrets. Our jwt_secret is generated via `openssl rand -base64 48` (384 bits) and used only for HS256 sign/verify in api/lib/jwt.php — no algorithm negotiation, no kid lookup. Not exploitable in this usage. No 7.x release exists to upgrade to as of 2026-05-23.
